title: CSS#89463 - Renovate and Repaint Interior USARC
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.ACC-CTRS.ACC-NJ.W6QK ACC-PICA
detail_text: This Source Sought posting is a Request for Information (RFI) issued solely for information and planning purposes and shall not be misconstrued as a Request for Quote (RFQ) nor does it constitute a commitment to the Government. All information submitted in response to this announcement is voluntary; the Government will not pay for information requested nor will it compensate any respondent for any cost incurred in developing information provided to the Government. Not responding to this RFI does not preclude participation in any future RFQ, if any is issued. The U.S. Army Contracting Command – New Jersey is seeking potential sources for CCS#89463 - Renovate and Repaint Interior USARC in Charlottesville, VA. Additional details of this project can be found in the Draft statement of work (SOW) attached.
